name: ATLAS 83 — original rebuild 01
externalNetworkNote: Two hosting-notice advertisement image requests aborted in public landscape; retained in raw networkFailures. No app response substitution. This does not establish the cause of the previous run's unattributed cross-origin console error.
features: New lofted hull, stepped superstructure and teak terraces
Bridge interior with moving wheel/levers and live numeric instrument displays
Aft pool, furniture, railings, stairs, foredeck fittings, mast and twin running gear
New ocean/coast scene, water reflection, weather and day/evening controls
Independent twin engine power, differential thrust, bow thruster and heading hold
Rate-limited rudder, thrust lag, inertial coast and damped wave response
Five camera modes, compact responsive controls, native pause/resume and chart
limitations: Authored concept parameters; not sea-trial calibrated, CFD or structural/navigation/flight-deck certification
Bridge is modeled; no fully walkable accommodation interior or accepted human contacts
Surface yacht only; the previous submarine demo remains a separate backup
No multiplayer or shared CORE/Station03/HUMANS integration
Fictional coast and approximate sampled grounding; decorative distant islands lack detailed collision geometry
Radar artwork is illustrative; numeric bridge readouts use real simulation state
Headless Chromium/SwiftShader viewport checks, not physical phones, Safari, optical latency or FPS certification
Slow rendering can slow simulation and trigger the unchanged explicit pause guard; native Resume is required
Old immutable demo/launcher URLs remain unchanged and do not automatically point to this rebuild
